name: manual_fa960a
claim: When disabling Requests environment trust to prevent proxy-based SSRF boundary shifts, preserve explicit CA configuration first: REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE takes precedence and CURL_CA_BUNDLE is the fallback.

decisions.notes: trust_env=False correctly disables inherited proxies but also stops Requests from discovering private CA bundles. Assigning session.verify before disabling trust keeps mTLS-adjacent private-CA deployments available without reopening proxy inheritance.
